name: FLOW Beat Link
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Sends each deck's beat, BPM, track, mixer and Stem FX / Drum Roll / loop state to FLOW VJ; can lead Ableton Link.
description:
Rows: Send beat to FLOW (on), Send mixer to FLOW (on), Send track analysis to FLOW (on), Ableton Link from this deck (off, test), Send decks to Ableton (off, test), Send mixer data (test) (off).

Link: the playing deck leads the Ableton Link session (tempo, beat, bar), no computer bridge. Link Audio offers each deck's sound to Ableton 12.4+ as inputs Deck 1-4.

FLOW: UDP port 9100: beats, BPM, titles, levels, rekordbox grid, waveform, phrases, cues, the mixer and AZ-MODS 1.2.6+ Stem FX, Drum Roll HOLD, loops. Uses Ableton Link (GPL-2.0-or-later). Reads files; never writes or patches the deck.
